Convert WEF Network Readiness Index Score to GDHI Indicator 15 Phase (1–5)

Source: R/gdhi_dictionary.R
wef_to_phase15.Rd

Maps numeric WEF Network Readiness Index scores (1.0 to 7.0) onto the 1–5 maturity scale defined for Indicator 15 in the GDHI Indicator Guidespan_6span_6.

Usage

wef_to_phase15(score)

Arguments

score

Numeric vector of WEF Network Readiness Index scores (1.0–7.0)span_7span_7.

Value

An integer vector with values from 1L to 5L (or NA_integer_ for NA inputs).

Examples

wef_to_phase15(c(2.5, 3.3, 3.7, 4.5, 5.2, 6.1))
#> [1] 1 1 2 3 4 5
